goal: Connect validation reports with prediction evaluation through a separate solver evaluation boundary and add regression coverage.

operations.old: A validation report boundary now consumes validated `SolverTrainingBatch` instances and returns framework-neutral structural metrics. The next solver step should connect batch validation reports with prediction evaluation without duplicating legality and shape checks between layers.
operations.new: A validation report boundary now consumes validated `SolverTrainingBatch` instances and returns framework-neutral structural metrics. A separate prediction evaluation boundary now consumes validation reports without duplicating legality and shape checks. Regression coverage now protects the validation-to-evaluation handoff. The next solver step should introduce model-output comparison metrics while keeping framework-specific training code outside the solver contract layer.
